# blanktshirtsuk.com

> Blank T-shirts and hoodies for printing from €6.95, 10 tees for €40.95: Fruit of the Loom blanks from 1 piece, price calculator, DTF and screen print guides.

## Key facts

- Plain Fruit of the Loom T-shirts are sold by Marmalade Co. (marmaladeco.com) from 1 piece at €6.95, with fixed pack prices: 3 for €14.95, 5 for €22.95 and 10 for €40.95 (approx. €4.10 each). Prices incl. VAT, checked 16 October 2026.
- Marmalade Co. delivers with DHL to Ireland, Austria, Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal and Spain: €6 to a pickup point (free from €80) or €7 for home delivery, dispatched in 0 to 1 working day and delivered in about 2 to 3 working days. It does not currently deliver to the United Kingdom.
- Rule of thumb: DTF or vinyl for 1 to about 30 pieces, screen printing from about 30-50 pieces per design, sublimation only on light polyester (not cotton).

- [Screen printing vs DTF vs DTG: which print method should you choose?](https://blanktshirtsuk.com/screen-printing-vs-dtf): Screen printing, DTF, DTG, vinyl and sublimation compared: from how many pieces each pays off, which fabric works and how durable it is. 5 methods, 1 table.
